releaseNotes.zh-Hans: 按参数写权限控制蓝牙入口：具备设置BMS参数、parameterWrite 或 super_admin 才显示蓝牙页；普通运营员只读权限不再显示蓝牙，并在权限变化时释放蓝牙控制器。
releaseNotes.zh-Hant: 依參數寫入權限控制藍牙入口：具備設定BMS參數、parameterWrite 或 super_admin 才顯示藍牙頁；普通營運員唯讀權限不再顯示藍牙，且權限變更時會釋放藍牙控制器。
releaseNotes.en: Gates Bluetooth maintenance by parameter-write access: setBMSParameters, parameterWrite, or super_admin can open Bluetooth; read-only operator accounts no longer see it, and BLE controllers are disposed when access is lost.
